outcome: Success rate of trial of labor
Admission to special care baby unit
cohort: Selected women with one previous cesarean section admitted for a trial of labor.
finding: Out of 150 women with one previous cesarean section undergoing a trial of labor, 70% achieved VBAC, while the ERCS cohort experienced significantly more maternal complications and higher rates of neonatal special care unit admission compared to the VBAC cohort.
mod_finding: Women undergoing emergency repeat cesarean section (ERCS) experienced significantly more maternal complications and had neonates more likely admitted to the special care baby unit compared to those achieving vaginal birth after cesarean (VBAC).
